name: @anyblades/blades

scripts.build: clear; npm run lint && npm run build:css && npm run build:minify && npm run build:conditional && npm run build:layered && npm run diff
scripts.build:css: for f in src/[!_]*.css; do RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 lightningcss --bundle $f -o css/${f#src/} || exit 1; done
scripts.build:minify: for f in css/*.css; do case $f in *.min.css|css/pico.conditional.*) ;; *) lightningcss --minify $f -o ${f%.css}.min.css || exit 1;; esac; done
scripts.build:layered: npm run build:layered:css && npm run build:layered:wrap
scripts.build:layered:css: for d in pico blades; do for f in $(find src/$d -name '_*.css' ! -path src/$d/_index.css); do o=css/layered/${f#src/$d/}; mkdir -p ${o%/*} && RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 lightningcss --bundle $f -o $o || exit 1; done; done
scripts.diff: npm run diff:css || true && npm run diff:unmin || true
scripts.diff:unmin: lightningcss css/pico.canonical.min.css -o css/pico.canonical.unmin.css && lightningcss css/pico.min.css -o css/pico.unmin.css && diff -u --label @picocss/pico/css/pico.css --label @anyblades/blades/css/pico.css css/pico.canonical.unmin.css css/pico.unmin.css > css/pico.min.css.diff

description: A modern drop‑in successor to Pico CSS.
